These 12 functions and methods in `src/flask/` call `ensure_sync(...)` directly. I found them by grepping for every `ensure_sync` call and checking which function each one sits in:

- `src/flask/app.py`: `update_template_context`, `handle_http_exception`, `handle_user_exception`, `handle_exception`, `dispatch_request`, `preprocess_request`, `process_response`, `do_teardown_request`, `do_teardown_appcontext`
- `src/flask/views.py`: `View.as_view` (the call is in the nested `view` closure) and `MethodView.dispatch_request`
- `src/flask/ctx.py`: `copy_current_request_context` (the call is in the nested `wrapper`)

I left out places that pass `ensure_sync` as `_async_wrapper=...` to signal `.send()` without calling it. These are in `helpers.py`, `templating.py`, `AppContext.push` and `AppContext.pop` in `ctx.py`, and some functions in `app.py`.
